summary: Produced the backend design artefact for EXT-03 at src/design/ext-03-plugin-interface.md. The design defines startup-only in-process plugin registration, stable Zig interface and compatibility/versioning boundaries, invocation context contract (instance variables and node config), strict outcome model (COMPLETE with optional output variables or ERROR with reason), plugin-over-built-in precedence, panic-to-ERROR mapping routed through EE-10, and COMPLETE output merge through EE-09. It also maps module boundaries and implementation touchpoints across engine execution path, plugin registry, startup wiring, and error/variable merge integration, with a complete traceability matrix of acceptance criteria and edge cases to unit/integration tests.

tests_run.name: design completeness and traceability review
tests_run.detail: Validated all EXT-03 acceptance criteria and edge cases are explicitly specified with module/function touchpoints and required unit/integration verification hooks, including startup-only registration, precedence shadowing, panic mapping, and EE-09/EE-10 integration.
